candidates.change_summary: Replace nonReentrant_ modifier to skip setting locked_ = true so reentrancy guard no longer prevents reentrant calls (only checks and resets), changing execution ordering and allowing reentrant Put effects.
Move the call to LogFile.AddMessage to occur before updating the holder's balance, so Put's observable log shows the old balance timing relative to the stored state.
Replace the conditional guard so Collect allows transfers even when acc.balance < MinSum, enabling withdrawals below MinSum.
Remove the check that block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime so Collect can withdraw regardless of unlock time.
Move the acc.balance subtraction to happen before the external call, preventing reentrancy from observing the old balance.
Remove the locking set before function body so nonReentrant_ no longer prevents reentrancy (only unlock after), allowing reentrant Collect calls to run.
